name: Gina AI Agents (Wakilan AI)
objectives: A cikin Colab notebook, rubuta tools biyu a matsayin Python functions masu sunaye a sarari, bayanin layi ɗaya da duba abin da aka shigar, kowane tool yana aiki idan kun kira shi da kanku
Idan kuna da tools ɗinku da wata manufa, rubuta system prompt da helper mai suna ask_model da ke sa model ya amsa da mataki ɗaya a JSON, ta yadda model zai zaɓi tool mai inganci ko amsar ƙarshe
Idan model ya zaɓi mataki, rubuta zagaye da ke gudanar da tool ɗin da aka zaɓa ya mayar da sakamakon ga model, har model ya ba da amsar ƙarshe
Yayin da agent ke aiki, tsara tarihin (history) da kyau da rubuta kowane mataki a rajistar aiki, da mataki, ainihin amsa, tool, abin da aka shigar da sakamako na kowane mataki

Idan model ya ba da amsa marar kyau, tool ya sami kuskure, ko aikin ya yi tsawo, ƙara iyakar matakai da sarrafa amsoshi marasa kyau da kurakuran tools, ta yadda agent zai farfaɗo ko ya tsaya ya ba da rahoto ba tare da ya rushe ba

Idan kun gama agent ɗinku, gwada shi da manufofi na yau da kullum da waɗanda ba za su yiwu ba, da bayyana lokacin da framework zai taimaka, kuna gudanar da gwaje-gwaje biyar duka kuma kuna rubuta abin da kuka gyara

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Zagayen agent a code

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Tools functions ne kawai
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rubuta tools biyu a matsayin Python functions masu sunaye da bayanai a sarari.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A cikin Colab notebook, za ku iya rubuta tools biyu a matsayin Python functions masu sunaye a sarari, bayanin layi ɗaya da duba abin da aka shigar, kowane tool yana aiki idan kun kira shi da kanku.
Ga agent, tool function ce da code ɗinku ke gudanarwa idan model ya nema. Model ba ya gudanar da komai da kansa: yana rubuta sunan tool da abin da za a shigar ne kawai. Code ɗinku ne ke yanke shawara ko za a gudanar da shi.
Ku fara da tools masu aminci da ke karantawa kawai. Calculator: def calculator(expression): da jiki da ke yarda da lambobi da + - * / ( ) . kawai, sannan ya lissafa amsar. Duban bayanai: NOTES = {'schedule': 'Class days: Mon, Wed, Thu'}, da def lookup_note(topic): return NOTES.get(topic, 'no note found').
Ku tara su a cikin dictionary don zagayen ya same su da suna: TOOLS = {'calculator': calculator, 'lookup_note': lookup_note}. Ku rubuta bayanin layi ɗaya na kowanne. Model yana karanta waɗannan bayanai don ya zaɓa, don haka suna da muhimmanci kamar code ɗin.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta kowane tool a matsayin Python function mai abin shigarwa ɗaya.
- Ku sa shi ya zama mai aminci: ku duba abin da aka shigar kafin amfani da shi.
- Ku mayar da rubutu da model zai iya karantawa, har da saƙo a sarari idan an kasa.
- Ku saka tools ɗin a cikin TOOLS dictionary.
- Ku rubuta bayanin layi ɗaya na kowane tool.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Function: wani yanki na code mai suna da ke karɓar abin shigarwa ya mayar da sakamako.
- Dictionary: tarin Python na sunaye da ƙimominsu bibbiyu, kamar {'calculator': calculator}.
- Tool mai karantawa kawai (read-only): tool da ke duba abubuwa kawai, ba ya canja komai.
Gwada yanzu: A cikin sabon Colab notebook, ku rubuta calculator da lookup_note, ku saka su a TOOLS, sannan ku gwada kowanne ta hanyar kiran sa da kanku: calculator('45*12/60') da lookup_note('schedule').
Yanzu za ku iya rubuta tools masu aminci a matsayin Python functions da yi musu rajista da suna.

check.q: A cikin agent ɗinku, mene ne tool?
options: Python function da code ɗinku ke gudanarwa idan model ya nema
Wani saiti a cikin model
Shafin intanet da model ke ziyarta da kansa
Model na AI na biyu
check.why: Model yana nema ne kawai; code ɗinku ne ke gudanar da function ɗin.

check.q: Tool ɗinku na lookup_note ya karɓi topic da babu shi a cikin bayanai. Me ya kamata ya yi?
options: Ya ƙirƙiri bayanin da zai iya yiwuwa
Ya rushe don ku lura
Ya mayar da saƙo a sarari cewa ba a sami topic ɗin ba
Ya mayar da dukkan dictionary na bayanai
check.why: Saƙo a sarari yana bar model ya gwada wata hanya maimakon ya yi tsammani.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Neman model ya faɗi mataki na gaba
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta prompt da ke sa model ya amsa da mataki ɗaya a JSON.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kuna da tools ɗinku da wata manufa, za ku iya rubuta system prompt da helper mai suna ask_model da ke sa model ya amsa da mataki ɗaya a JSON, ta yadda model zai zaɓi tool mai inganci ko amsar ƙarshe.
Model yana buƙatar sanin manufar, tools ɗin da tsarin amsa. System prompt ɗinku yana jera kowane tool da bayaninsa, kuma yana cewa: ka amsa da JSON kawai, ko dai {"tool": "name", "input": "..."} don amfani da tool, ko {"final": "..."} idan an cimma manufar.
Ku ƙara ƙa'idoji daga katin tsarinku: a yi amfani da tools da aka jera kawai; mataki ɗaya a kowace amsa; idan sakamakon tool ya ce an kasa, a gwada wata hanya; kada a taɓa ƙirƙirar sakamakon tool.
Ku rubuta helper don sauran code ɗinku kada ya damu da wane mai samar da model (provider) kuke amfani da shi: def ask_model(text): da ke kiran model ɗinku (ku kwafi kiran daga quickstart na provider ɗinku, kamar a kwas na 2) ya mayar da rubutun amsar. Idan kun canja provider daga baya, ask_model kaɗai ke canjawa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku jera sunan kowane tool da bayaninsa a cikin system prompt.
- Ku ba da siffofin amsa guda biyu na JSON: tool ko final.
- Ku ƙara ƙa'idojin daga katin tsarinku.
- Ku rubuta ask_model(text) da ke mayar da rubutun amsar model.
- Ku gwada shi sau ɗaya da manufar ku buga amsar.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Mataki (action): abu ɗaya da agent ya yanke shawarar yi na gaba, kamar amfani da tool ko ba da amsar ƙarshe.
- Helper function: ƙaramar function da ke ɓoye cikakkun bayanai, kamar wane provider na model kuke kira.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta system prompt da ask_model. Ku aika manufar aikin ƙarshe ku buga amsar. Shin ya zaɓi lookup_note da farko? Idan bai zaɓa ba, ku inganta bayanan tools ɗin.
Yanzu za ku iya sa model ya zaɓi mataki na gaba a JSON daga jerin tools.

check.q: Yaya amsar model ya kamata ta kasance idan yana son tool?
options: Sakin layi mai daɗi da ke bayyana shirinsa
Mataki ɗaya na JSON da ke faɗin sunan tool da abin shigarwa
Code na Python na tool ɗin
Jerin dukkan tools
check.why: Mataki ɗaya na JSON abu ne da zagayenku zai iya karantawa ya gudanar.

check.q: Model yana ci gaba da zaɓar calculator kafin ya sami ranakun aji. Me za ku fara canjawa?
options: Ku cire calculator
Ku ƙara iyakar matakai
Ku koma ga framework
Ku inganta bayanan tools don ya san cewa sai ya fara duba bayanai
check.why: Model yana zaɓar tools daga bayanansu, don haka bayanai masu sarari suna jagorantar zaɓinsa.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Gudanar da zagayen: yi aiki ka mayar da sakamako
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta zagayen da ke gudanar da tool ɗin da aka zaɓa ya mayar da sakamakon.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan model ya zaɓi mataki, za ku iya rubuta zagaye da ke gudanar da tool ɗin da aka zaɓa ya mayar da sakamakon ga model, har model ya ba da amsar ƙarshe.
Zagayen gajere ne. history = [] yana riƙe abin da ya faru. A kowane mataki: ku haɗa rubutun (system prompt, manufa, history), ku kira ask_model, ku karanta (parse) JSON ɗin. Idan yana da 'final', ku buga shi ku tsaya. Idan yana da 'tool', ku nemo shi a TOOLS, ku gudanar da shi da abin shigarwa, ku ƙara layi a history: matakin da sakamakon.
Mayar da sakamakon shi ne matakin lura (observe) daga kwas na 1. Ba tare da shi ba, model zai ci gaba da neman abu ɗaya har abada. Da shi, model yana ganin "lookup_note(schedule) returned: Class days: Mon, Wed, Thu" kuma zai iya yanke mataki na gaba, kamar amfani da calculator.
Idan model ya faɗi sunan tool da babu shi a TOOLS, kada ku bari ya rushe: ku ƙara "Unknown tool: X. Use one of: calculator, lookup_note" a history ku ci gaba. Saƙonni a sarari ga model su ne yadda agent ke farfaɗowa daga kurakuransa.
Mataki-mataki:
- history = []
- Ku haɗa rubutun: system prompt, manufa, history.
- Ku kira ask_model ku karanta JSON ɗin.
- Idan 'final' ne: ku buga ku tsaya.
- Idan 'tool' ne: ku gudanar da shi daga TOOLS ku ƙara matakin da sakamakon a history.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- History (tarihi): jerin matakai da sakamakon da agent ya gani a wannan aikin, da ke ƙaruwa.
- Lura (observation): sakamakon tool, da ake mayar wa model.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta zagayen ku gudanar da shi da manufar aikin ƙarshe. Ku buga history bayan kowane mataki. Ku ƙirga matakai nawa ya ɗauka kafin ya kai amsar ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya rubuta zagayen agent da ke gudanar da tools ya mayar da sakamakon ga model.

check.q: Mene ne matakin lura (observe) a cikin zagayen?
options: Ƙara sakamakon tool a history don model ya gan shi
Buga amsar ƙarshe
Zaɓar wane tool za a rubuta
Duba API key
check.why: Mayar da sakamakon yana bar model ya yanke mataki na gaba bisa abin da ya faru.

check.q: Agent ɗinku yana kiran tool ɗaya akai-akai. Mene ne gyara mafi yiwuwa?
options: Ku ƙara tools
Ku tabbata ana mayar da kowane sakamakon tool a cikin history
Ku gajarta system prompt
Ku yi amfani da wani notebook daban
check.why: Ba tare da sakamakon a history ba, model bai san cewa an riga an gudanar da matakin ba.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Sa agent ya zama amintacce

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Ƙwaƙwalwa da rajistar aiki
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tsara ƙwaƙwalwar ɗan lokaci da kyau da rubuta kowane mataki a rajista.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Yayin da agent ke aiki, za ku iya tsara tarihin (history) da kyau da rubuta kowane mataki a rajistar aiki, da mataki, ainihin amsa, tool, abin da aka shigar da sakamako na kowane mataki.
Ƙwaƙwalwar ɗan lokaci (short-term memory) ita ce jerin history da kuke da shi. Yana ƙaruwa a kowane mataki, kuma ana aika duk abin da ke cikinsa ga model, wanda ke cin tokens da lokaci. Don dogon aiki, ku ajiye matakai na ƙarshe kaɗan cikakku, ku maye gurbin tsofaffin matakai da taƙaitawa ta layi ɗaya.
Ƙwaƙwalwar dogon lokaci (long-term memory) ita ce duk abin da aka ajiye tsakanin ayyuka: fayil na bayanai, spreadsheet, ƙaramin database. Ku ajiye abin da agent ke buƙata da gaske a gaba kawai, kuma kada ku taɓa ajiye bayanan sirri da ba ku buƙata.
Rajistar aiki (run log) don ku ce, ba don model ba. A kowane mataki, ku rubuta lambar mataki, ainihin amsar model, tool da abin shigarwa, sakamakon da lokaci. Idan agent ya yi wani abu mai ban mamaki, rajistar tana faɗa muku dalili. Hanya mai sauƙi: log.append({'step': n, 'reply': reply, 'result': result}) sannan ku buga shi a ƙarshe.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Ƙwaƙwalwar ɗan lokaci (short-term memory): abin da agent ke gani a cikin aiki ɗaya: history zuwa yanzu.
- Ƙwaƙwalwar dogon lokaci (long-term memory): bayanan da aka ajiye tsakanin ayyuka, kamar fayil na bayanai.
- Rajistar aiki (run log): bayananku na kowane mataki da agent ya ɗauka, don dubawa da gyara kurakurai.
Gwada yanzu: Ku ƙara jerin log a agent ɗinku ku rubuta kowane mataki. Ku gudanar da shi, sannan ku buga log ɗin a matsayin tebur mai kyau: mataki, tool, abin shigarwa, sakamako.
Yanzu za ku iya sarrafa ƙwaƙwalwar agent da ajiye rajistar aiki da za ku iya karantawa.

check.q: Mece ce ƙwaƙwalwar ɗan lokaci a cikin agent ɗinku?
options: Fayil da aka ajiye har abada
Bayanan horon model
Jerin history na wannan aikin
Dictionary na bayanai
check.why: Ƙwaƙwalwar ɗan lokaci ita ce history da agent ke riƙewa a cikin aiki ɗaya.

check.q: Agent ya ba da amsa mai ban mamaki kuma kuna son sanin dalili. Me za ku duba?
options: Amsar ƙarshe kawai
API key
Bayanan tools kawai
Rajistar aiki ta kowane mataki
check.why: Rajistar tana nuna kowace amsa, tool, abin shigarwa da sakamako, don ku ga inda aka yi kuskure.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Iyakar matakai, amsoshi marasa kyau da kurakurai
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Ƙara iyakar matakai da sarrafa amsoshi marasa kyau daga model da kurakuran tools.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan model ya ba da amsa marar kyau, tool ya sami kuskure, ko aikin ya yi tsawo, za ku iya ƙara iyakar matakai da sarrafa amsoshi marasa kyau da kurakuran tools, ta yadda agent zai farfaɗo ko ya tsaya ya ba da rahoto ba tare da ya rushe ba.
Kowane zagaye yana buƙatar iyaka: MAX_STEPS = 6 da for step in range(MAX_STEPS): maimakon zagaye da ke tafiya har abada. Idan ya kai iyakar ba tare da amsar ƙarshe ba, ku tsaya ku ba da rahoton "Stopped: step limit reached" tare da rajistar.
Amsoshi marasa kyau suna faruwa: ƙarin kalmomi a kewayen JSON, maɓalli (key) da ya ɓace, amsa marar komai. Ku karanta (parse) a cikin try da except. Idan an kasa, ku ƙara "Your last reply was not valid JSON. Reply with only JSON." a history ku bar mataki na gaba ya sake gwadawa. Ku ƙirga waɗannan; idan aka sami biyu a jere, ku tsaya.
Tools ma suna kasawa: calculator ya karɓi haruffa, fayil ya ɓace. Kowane tool ya kamata ya kama kurakuransa ya mayar da saƙo a sarari kamar "calculator error: only numbers and + - * / allowed". Sai model ya gyara abin shigarwarsa a mataki na gaba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku saita MAX_STEPS ku yi zagaye da range(MAX_STEPS).
- Ku karanta amsoshi a cikin try / except.
- Idan amsa ba ta yi kyau ba, ku faɗa wa model ku ci gaba.
- Ku tsaya bayan amsoshi marasa kyau biyu a jere.
- Ku sa kowane tool ya mayar da saƙon kuskure a sarari maimakon ya rushe.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Iyakar matakai (step limit): mafi yawan matakan da agent zai iya ɗauka a aiki ɗaya.
- Exception: kuskure da ke faruwa yayin da shiri ke aiki; try / except yana kama shi.
Gwada yanzu: Ku gwada code ɗinku na tsaro: na ɗan lokaci, ku sa ask_model ya mayar da "hello" a mataki na 2, ku aika wa calculator abin shigarwa 'abc'. Ku duba cewa agent ya farfaɗo, kuma yana tsayawa a iyakar matakai idan kuka saita MAX_STEPS = 2.
Yanzu za ku iya hana agent yin zagaye har abada da taimaka masa ya farfaɗo daga amsoshi marasa kyau da kurakuran tools.

options: Yana saita iyakar matakan da agent zai iya ɗauka
Yana sa model ya amsa da sauri
Yana iyakance tools nawa za ku iya rubutawa
Yana saita tsawon rajistar
check.why: Iyakar matakai tana tsayar da aikin da zai iya ci gaba ba ƙarewa.

check.q: Model ya amsa "hello" maimakon JSON a mataki ɗaya. Me agent ɗinku ya kamata ya yi?
options: Ya rushe
Ya ɗauki "hello" a matsayin amsar ƙarshe
Ya faɗa wa model ya amsa da JSON kawai ya ci gaba
Ya sake fara dukkan aikin daga mataki na 1
check.why: Ana iya farfaɗowa daga amsa marar kyau ɗaya; agent yana tsayawa ne bayan amsoshi marasa kyau da suka maimaita.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Frameworks, da kammala agent ɗinku na farko
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Kammala da gwada agent ɗinku, da sanin lokacin da framework zai taimaka.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kun gama agent ɗinku, za ku iya gwada shi da manufofi na yau da kullum da waɗanda ba za su yiwu ba, da bayyana lokacin da framework zai taimaka, kuna gudanar da gwaje-gwaje biyar duka kuma kuna rubuta abin da kuka gyara.
Frameworks na agents libraries ne da ke ba ku zagaye, sarrafa tools da ƙwaƙwalwa a shirye. Sanannu sun haɗa da LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK da Agent Development Kit na Google, kuma masu samar da models da yawa suna da native tool calling, inda model ke mayar muku da buƙatar tool a tsararren tsari. Suna canjawa sau da yawa, don haka ku karanta takardun bayanin kowane aiki (documentation) don saitin zamani.
Gina zagayen da kanku da farko yana nufin kun fahimci abin da framework ke yi muku, kuma za ku iya gyara shi idan ya lalace. Yawancin agents na gaske har yanzu zagaye ne mai sauƙi kamar naku.
Kafin ku ce agent ɗinku ya kammala, ku gwada shi kamar a kwas na 2: manufofi uku da ya kamata ya kammala, ɗaya da ba zai iya ba (ya kamata ya faɗi haka, ba ya ƙirƙiri amsa ba), da abin shigarwa marar kyau ɗaya. Ku karanta rajistar kowane aiki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku gudanar da agent ɗin da manufofi uku da ya kamata ya kammala.
- Ku gudanar da manufa ɗaya da ba zai iya kammalawa ba: ya kamata ya faɗi haka.
- Ku gudanar da abin shigarwa marar kyau ɗaya.
- Ku karanta rajistar kowane aiki.
- Ku gyara rauni ɗaya ku sake gudanar da dukkan biyar ɗin.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Framework: library da aka shirya da ke sarrafa sassan shiri na yau da kullum a madadinku.
- Native tool calling: fasalin model inda model ke mayar da buƙata a tsararren tsari don amfani da tool.
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku kammala agent ɗinku mai tools biyu kan manufar awoyin karatu, da iyakar matakai 6, amsa marar kyau ɗaya da aka farfaɗo daga ita, da rajistar kowane mataki da aka buga. Sannan ku gudanar da gwaje-gwaje biyar na sama ku rubuta jimloli biyu kan abin da kuka gyara.
Yanzu za ku iya gina, gwada da bayyana AI agent mai aiki a Python mai sauƙi.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Tools biyu masu aiki Wani tool ya ɓace, yana rushewa, ko ba shi da bayani. Dukkan tools biyu suna aiki, suna da sunaye da bayanai a sarari, kuma suna duba abin da aka shigar. Tools suna mayar da saƙonnin kuskure a sarari da model zai iya amfani da su. Matakai a JSON Model yana amsa da rubutu kawai da zagayen ba zai iya karantawa ba. Model yana zaɓar tools da amsar ƙarshe a JSON. Prompt ɗin kuma yana faɗa wa model kada ya taɓa ƙirƙirar sakamakon tool. Zagaye yana mayar da sakamako Ba a mayar da sakamakon tools, ko zagayen ba ya ƙarewa. Zagayen yana gudanar da tool ɗin da aka zaɓa, yana mayar da sakamakon, kuma yana tsayawa a amsar ƙarshe. Ana sarrafa sunayen tools da ba a sani ba ta hanyar faɗa wa model waɗanne tools ne akwai. Iyakokin tsaro Babu iyakar matakai, ko amsa marar kyau tana rushe agent. Yana tsayawa a iyakar matakai 6 kuma yana farfaɗowa daga amsa marar kyau ɗaya daga model. Yana kuma sarrafa kuskuren tool kuma yana tsayawa bayan amsoshi marasa kyau biyu a jere. Rajistar aiki Babu rajista, ko wasu matakai sun ɓace daga cikinta. Yana buga rajistar kowane mataki. Rajistar tebur ce mai kyau da wani mutum zai iya karantawa don bayyana aikin. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

options: Doka da ke hana tools
Zagaye, tools da ƙwaƙwalwa a shirye da za ku iya amfani da su maimakon rubuta naku
Model kyauta
Wani nau'in API key
check.why: Frameworks suna haɗa sassan da kuka gina da hannu a wannan kwas.

check.q: Kun ba agent ɗinku manufa da ba zai iya kaiwa da tools ɗinsa ba. Me agent nagari ya kamata ya yi?
options: Ya faɗi cewa ba zai iya kammalawa ba ya nuna abin da ya gwada
Ya ƙirƙiri amsa da take kama da daidai
Ya ci gaba da aiki har abada
Ya kira tool da babu shi
check.why: Agent mai gaskiya yana ba da rahoton abin da bai iya yi ba maimakon ya ƙirƙiri wani abu.
